families.product_name: Philips EPIQ / Affiniti / Compact 5000 cardiac AI features (Auto Measure, Smart Doppler View ID, Smart View Select, Segmental Wall Motion, 3D Auto TV, 3D Auto CFQ, Auto EF with contrast, R-Trigger)
families.summary: Series of ten 510(k) clearances (2021-2025) adding AI/ML cardiac features to the Philips EPIQ and Affiniti cart-based ultrasound systems (software VM9-VM13) and the 5000 Compact Series: semi-automated 2D/Doppler/M-mode adult TTE measurements (Auto Measure V1-V3), Doppler-spectrum classification for calculation-package navigation (Smart Doppler View ID), deep-learning apical view selection for AutoStrain LV / 2D Auto LV / contrast EF (Smart View Select v1, v2, v2 Contrast), ML segmental wall-motion scoring (SWM, SWM v2), ML model-based 3D tricuspid annulus quantification (3D Auto TV), fluid-dynamic 3D color-flow MR quantification using an ML-generated mitral model (3D Auto CFQ), AI contrast-enhanced biplane LVEF (Auto EF with contrast), and an AI R-wave timing backup for clips without ECG (R-Trigger). Several features integrate DiA Imaging Analysis LVivo algorithms (K212466, K161382, K243862, K243235). All clearances relied on retrospective standalone performance studies; no clinical investigation was required for any of them.
families.intended_use_quote: The intended use of EPIQ Ultrasound Diagnostic System is diagnostic ultrasound imaging and fluid flow analysis of the human body.
families.indications_for_use_quote: The intended use of EPIQ Ultrasound Diagnostic System is diagnostic ultrasound imaging and fluid flow analysis of the human body, with the following indications for use: Abdominal, Cardiac Adult, Cardiac other (Fetal), Cardiac Pediatric, Cerebral Vascular, Cephalic (Adult), Cephalic (Neonatal), Fetal/Obstetric, Gynecological, Intraoperative (Vascular), Intraoperative (Cardiac), intra-luminal, intra-cardiac echo, Musculoskeletal (Conventional), Musculoskeletal (Superficial), Ophthalmic, Other: Urology, Pediatric, Peripheral Vessel, Small Organ (Breast, Thyroid, Testicle), Transesophageal (Cardiac), Transrectal, Transvaginal, Lung.

embedded_ai_features.name: Auto Measure (AutoMeasure V1 / V2 / V3)
embedded_ai_features.function: AI/ML detection algorithm that initializes caliper positions for a subset of adult TTE 2D, Doppler and (V3) M-mode measurements (e.g., IVSd, LVIDd, LVIDs, LVPWd, aortic diameters, LVOT diam, RV dimensions, TV annulus, MV E/A, decel time, LVOT/AV/PV VTI and Vmax, TR Vmax, TDI e'/a', RV S', TAPSE, LA/RA volumes, MR/TR VTI); user edits, accepts or rejects. Requires ECG (until R-Trigger) and an adult cardiology TTE transducer.
embedded_ai_features.quote: The Philips Auto Measure feature provides the end user with semi-automated functionality for a subset of 2D and Doppler measurements currently available on the Philips EPIQ and Affiniti systems when performing or reviewing an adult transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) with simultaneously acquired electrocardiogram (ECG). The AI/ML-enabled algorithm is designed to produce semi-automated and editable measures.

embedded_ai_features.name: Smart Doppler View ID
embedded_ai_features.function: AI classification of an acquired adult-TTE Doppler spectrum (PW/CW/TDI) to automatically select one of six Doppler calculation-package touch-screen groups (Aortic Valve, Mitral Valve, Tricuspid Valve, Pulmonic Valve, Venous Flow, TDI Vel & Ratio). Performs no measurements itself.
embedded_ai_features.quote: The Smart Doppler View ID feature automates this navigation and selects the associated calculation package group for the user based on the provided Doppler Spectrum acquired by the user using an artificial intelligence-based algorithm.

embedded_ai_features.name: Smart View Select (SVS v1, v2, v2 Contrast)
embedded_ai_features.function: Deep-learning view classification of each acquired adult TTE image (LVivo Seamless neural network, DiA K212466) plus a non-AI depth heuristic to select the optimal A4C/A2C/A3C triplet for AutoStrain LV or 2D Auto LV (v1, EPIQ only); v2 revised the network and depth logic and extended to Affiniti; v2 Contrast selects the optimal contrast-enhanced A4C/A2C pair for 2D Auto EF Adv.
embedded_ai_features.quote: Smart View Select is an automated software feature that assists the user in selection of images for analysis with the existing Philips AutoStrain LV or 2D Auto LV application in Adult Echo Transthoracic (TTE) examination. This feature automatically classif ies each acquired image by view and selects an appropriate set of images for left ventricle (LV) analysis. The classification is based on a Deep Learning AI interface engine; the selection is a non-AI algorithm that considers the view classification and image depth to select the optimal set of images.

embedded_ai_features.name: Segmental Wall Motion (SWM, SWM v2)
embedded_ai_features.function: Machine-learning semi-automated evaluation of LV regional function from A4C/A2C/A3C: border detection and tracking, per-segment wall-motion score for 17 LV segments and Wall Motion Score Index; users edit scores via drop-down. Integrates DiA LVivo SG (K161382; v2 = K243862) with AutoStrain LV border initialization as backup.
embedded_ai_features.quote: The application then provides segmental wall motion scores for each of the 17 segments of the LV by using machine learning algorithms and an overall wall motion score index (WMSI) is calculated as the average of the segmental scores.

embedded_ai_features.name: 3D Auto TV (Tricuspid Valve)
embedded_ai_features.function: Semi-automated 3D TTE/TEE tricuspid annulus quantification via machine-learning model-based segmentation (same method as QLAB 3D Auto MV, K200974, retrained on tricuspid images); outputs TV annulus perimeter (2D/3D), max/min diameter, perimeter-derived diameter, height and area; user edits/accepts/rejects landmark proposals.
embedded_ai_features.quote: 3D surface model is created semi-automatically using machine learning algorithm without user interaction. User is able to edit, accept, or reject the initial landmark proposals of the mitral valve anatomical locations.

embedded_ai_features.name: 3D Auto CFQ (Color Flow Quantification)
embedded_ai_features.function: Semi-automated quantification of mitral regurgitant volume and peak flow rate from 3D color-flow TEE (X8-2t) using an iterative fluid-dynamic flow model; the 3D mitral valve model input is generated by the machine-learning segmentation of 3D Auto MV (K200974).
embedded_ai_features.quote: The 3D Auto CFQ software provides semi-automated quantification of Mitral Regurgitation (MR) volume and peak flow rate based on 3D color flow images. This application uses a known fluid dynamic model of flow that is adapted to the acquired color information.

embedded_ai_features.name: Auto EF with contrast (2D Auto EF Advanced)
embedded_ai_features.function: AI-based automated LVEF from contrast-enhanced A4C and A2C adult TTE clips (single-plane EF each plus biplane Simpson's EF) with manual border edit on ED/ES frames; DiA LVivo CE-EF algorithm (K243235) integrated unmodified into VM13.
embedded_ai_features.quote: Auto EF with contrast is an AI based automated software feature that assists clinicians with assessing Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction ( LVEF) from images acquired with contrast agent as part of an adult transthoracic echo (TTE) examination. The feature is located within the Philips Auto EF Adv application.

embedded_ai_features.name: R-Trigger (AI, non-ECG R-wave detection)
embedded_ai_features.function: AI algorithm that detects the R-wave peak timestamp directly from acquired TTE clips when the ECG physio signal is unavailable or unusable, serving as backup input for AutoStrain LV, AutoEF, 2D Auto LV and AutoMeasure; runs in the background (VM13).
embedded_ai_features.quote: The R-Trigger AI software feature on Philips EPIQ and Affiniti Ultrasound System is intended to support detection of R-wave peak (R-trigger) as an input to AutoStrain and AutoMeasure applications, as well as other cardiac clinical applications.

embedded_ai_features.name: AutoStrain LV / 2D Auto LV (downstream LV EF and GLS applications)
embedded_ai_features.function: Existing Philips LV strain (GLS) and biplane EF applications that consume clips selected by Smart View Select and R-Trigger timing; cleared under K190913 (outside this batch) and referenced as previously cleared in K240850 and K243793.
embedded_ai_features.quote: The Auto-Measure and AutoStrain features, cleared on Philips EPIQ and Affiniti systems (K211597, K190913 resp.) support users during B -mode (2D), CW -, PW-  and TDI -Doppler measurements by automating some of the measurements needed to complete a routine transthoracic echo (TTE) exam for adult patients.

clearances.changes_summary: Introduced Auto Measure (V1) AI/ML semi-automated 2D and Doppler adult TTE measurements on EPIQ and Affiniti (software release 9.0). Reference device K200974 (QLAB 3D Auto MV). No performance numbers in summary.
notable_flags: no quantitative performance results in summary
applicant listed as Philips Medical Systems in openFDA

clearances.changes_summary: Introduced Smart Doppler View ID: AI classification of Doppler spectra to auto-select the Doppler calculation-package group (software 11.0+). Standalone accuracy study on 1100 clips from 400 subjects.

Introduced Smart View Select v1 (EPIQ; DiA LVivo Seamless network) and Segmental Wall Motion (EPIQ and Affiniti; DiA LVivo SG) on VM11. Two retrospective studies with Pearson r endpoints; sample sizes not stated.
notable_flags: sample sizes not stated in summary

clearances.changes_summary: Introduced 3D Auto TV (ML model-based tricuspid annulus quantification, TTE and TEE) and 3D Auto CFQ (3D color-flow MR volume and peak flow rate, TEE X8-2t) on EPIQ VM11. Validation vs TOMTEC 4D Cardio-View (TV) and cardiac MRI / 2D PISA (CFQ); sample sizes not stated.
notable_flags: sample sizes not stated in summary

clearances.changes_summary: Introduced Auto Measure Version 2 (subset of CNN detectors retrained with additional data; locked algorithm) onto the 5000 Compact Series (Compact 2.0 / VM11.0); adds QIH product code to Compact. Per-detector Bland-Altman results on 500 unseen studies and training-pool description (>6000 studies, 20 centers, 16 countries).
notable_flags: only clearance in batch that discloses training-data size

clearances.changes_summary: AutoMeasure V3 on EPIQ and Affiniti VM13: adds M-mode TAPSE, new 2D (LA Vol A2C/A4C, LA diameter PLAX, RA volume, aortic annulus diameter) and Doppler (MR VTI, TR VTI) measurements, new detectors, and retrained existing detectors. Validation on 7127 clips from 3964 subjects (32 hypotheses); no per-parameter values in summary.
notable_flags: per-parameter results not reported in summary

clearances.changes_summary: VM13: replaced SWM with SWM v2 (DiA K243862, unmodified) and introduced Auto EF with contrast (DiA LVivo CE-EF, K243235, unmodified) within the Auto EF Adv application on EPIQ and Affiniti. Philips-data sub-analysis r=0.952 for contrast biplane EF; SWM v2 sensitivity/specificity not numerically reported.
notable_flags: sample size not stated in summary

clearances.changes_summary: Introduced R-Trigger AI (non-ECG R-wave timestamp detection) as backup input for AutoStrain LV / AutoEF / 2D Auto LV and AutoMeasure on EPIQ and Affiniti VM13. 35 hypotheses on 7309 clips from 3964 subjects; full per-parameter LoA table and race/region/age/BMI stratification reported.
notable_flags: most detailed performance table in batch

clearances.changes_summary: Smart View Select v2: revised neural network and depth heuristic (12-20 cm) on EPIQ and expansion to Affiniti (VM13). EF r=0.891, GLS r=0.906 vs expert-selected clips; total N not stated (demographics for a 71-patient US subset).
notable_flags: total study N not stated in summary

clearances.changes_summary: SVS v2 Contrast: view-selection algorithm revised to pick the optimal contrast-enhanced A4C/A2C pair for 2D Auto EF Adv (and feed 2D Auto EF, AutoStrain LV, 2D Auto LV) on EPIQ and Affiniti VM13. Sub-analysis of K240850/K243235 data: 46 evaluable subjects, r=0.953.

training_data.description: Auto Measure detectors (K242800): training pool of more than 6000 anonymized TTE studies (n_studies = 6000 is a stated lower bound) from cardially healthy individuals and patients with echo indications, acquired 2010-2021 in 20 centers and 16 countries; annotated by qualified echocardiography professionals using TTA software or Philips systems; all detectors trained from scratch (no pretrained weights); validation data randomly sampled and separated before development. Training-set sizes for Smart Doppler View ID, SVS, SWM, 3D Auto TV, 3D Auto CFQ, Auto EF with contrast and R-Trigger are not disclosed in the FDA summaries (SVS/SWM/contrast EF algorithms originate from DiA LVivo clearances).

validation_data.description: Largest validation set in the batch: AutoMeasure V3 (K243794) 7127 TTE clips from 3964 adult subjects, multi-institution (USA, Asia, Europe), enrolled 2015-June 2024; the same 3964-subject cohort (7309 clips) was used for R-Trigger (K243793). Other feature validations: Smart Doppler View ID 1100 clips / 400 subjects, one US hospital (K233788); Auto Measure V2 detectors 500 studies (K242800); SVS v2 Contrast 46 evaluable subjects from 2 sites (K251455); SVS v1/v2, SWM, SWM v2, 3D Auto TV, 3D Auto CFQ and Auto EF with contrast sample sizes not stated (K240850, K240980, K250886, K251110).
validation_data.source: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-ASERegistryExample/90389ae4-4b72-5b0c-b942-f3b316841bea/scratchpad/probe/txt/K243794.txt (pp. 15-16); K233788.txt (p. 10: 'completely distinct from that used during training'); K242800.txt (p. 20); K251455.txt (p. 12)

prior_validations.description: Smart View Select v1 uses the unchanged LVivo Seamless deep neural network cleared as DiA LVivo Seamless (K212466); SWM integrates the LVivo SG module (K161382) and SWM v2 the K243862 LVivo algorithm; Auto EF with contrast integrates the LVivo CE-EF algorithm (K243235) without modification.
3D Auto TV uses the same machine-learning model-based contour generation as QLAB 3D Auto MV (K200974), retrained on tricuspid valve images; 3D Auto CFQ uses the K200974 mitral model as input.
Acceptance criteria for SVS and contrast-EF studies were informed by prior clearances K130779 and K232500 (Lumify Auto EF) and Maret et al. 2008 (Cardiovasc Ultrasound).

papers.title: Mitral Regurgitation Assessment Using a Novel Automated Three-Dimensional Color-Flow Quantification: Comparison with Two-Dimensional Proximal Isovelocity Surface Area and Cardiac Magnetic Resonance
papers.journal: Journal of the American Society of Echocardiography
papers.key_result: 3D Auto CFQ on 185 consecutive TEE MR patients: feasibility 97.3%; intra/inter-observer ICC 0.96/0.91; RVol lower than 2D PISA (36.3 vs 65.9 mL) with fewer severe classifications (16.2% vs 53.3%); in a 29-patient CMR subgroup, agreement with CMR r=0.860 (ICC 0.92) vs 2D PISA r=0.694 (ICC 0.64).

papers.title: Initial Experience With Automated 3D Color Flow Quantification of Mitral Regurgitation
papers.key_result: Technical/practical description of the Philips 3D Automated Color Flow Quantification tool in severe-MR patients undergoing TEER; states further validation is needed and accuracy depends on 3D color acquisition quality. No numeric accuracy result in abstract.

papers.title: A Novel Approach for Semiautomated Three-Dimensional Quantification of Mitral Regurgitant Volume Reflects a More Physiologic Approach to Mitral Regurgitation
papers.journal: Journal of the American Society of Echocardiography
papers.key_result: Semiautomated 3D color-flow RVol with dynamic flow curves compared with 2D PISA (r=0.60); 3D RVol significantly lower than 2D PISA. Abstract does not name the vendor; relation to 3D Auto CFQ inferred from method description only (see open_questions).

papers.title: Three-Dimensional Transthoracic Echocardiography for Semiautomated Analysis of the Tricuspid Annulus: Validation and Normal Values
papers.journal: Journal of the American Society of Echocardiography
papers.key_result: New semiautomated 3D TTE tricuspid annulus software vs multiplanar reconstruction in 113 patients (3 readers): all r > 0.8, minimal bias, better reproducibility (ICC 0.94-0.96 vs 0.82-0.90); normal values from 789 WASE subjects. Abstract does not name the software vendor (see open_questions).

papers.title: Feasibility, Reproducibility, and Clinical Implications of the Novel Fully Automated Assessment for Global Longitudinal Strain
papers.journal: Journal of the American Society of Echocardiography
papers.key_result: Fully automated AutoStrain GLS feasible in 99.5% of 561 community subjects; 0.5 min/patient vs 4.5 min manual; about 40% of automated traces judged to need manual correction; automated GLS predictive value inferior to semi-automated GLS. Applies to AutoStrain LV (K190913), the downstream application for Smart View Select and R-Trigger.

open_questions: K211597 (Auto Measure V1) summary reports no quantitative performance results and no sample sizes; only that a Performance Validation Study was conducted.
K240850, K240980, K250886 (total N) and K251110 do not state validation sample sizes; K243794 does not report per-parameter numeric results despite 32 hypotheses.
Training-set sizes are disclosed only for Auto Measure V2 (K242800, >6000 studies); none disclosed for Smart Doppler View ID, SVS, SWM, 3D Auto TV, 3D Auto CFQ, Auto EF with contrast, or R-Trigger.
Number of validation sites for AutoMeasure V3 / R-Trigger is described only as 'multiple institutions, including USA, Asia and Europe'; exact count not stated.

No PubMed-indexed peer-reviewed validation of Philips Auto Measure / AutoMeasure, Smart Doppler View ID, Smart View Select, R-Trigger, or the on-cart Auto EF with contrast was found by feature-name search this session; the vendor 51% time-savings claim (press release footnote [2]) could not be traced to a citable study.
Cotella 2025 (tricuspid annulus) and Singh 2022 (3D MR volume) abstracts do not name the software vendor; their mapping to 3D Auto TV / 3D Auto CFQ is inferred and unconfirmed.
AutoStrain LV / 2D Auto LV (K190913) and QLAB 3D Auto MV (K200974) are referenced as previously cleared but are outside this batch; their own summaries were not reviewed here.
openFDA lists the K211597 applicant as 'Philips Medical Systems' while the summary names Philips Ultrasound, Inc.; later clearances list Philips Ultrasound, LLC.
K242800 training-pool figure is stated as 'more than 6000 studies'; n_studies=6000 is recorded as a lower bound, not an exact count.

families.product_name: Philips Lumify Auto EF Quantification (DiA LVivo EF on handheld)
families.summary: Auto EF Quantification on the Philips Lumify handheld ultrasound (Android, Lumify 5.0, S4-1 transducer, Cardiac preset) is a subset of the DiA Imaging Analysis LVivo EF algorithm (K210053) that automatically traces and tracks the LV endocardial border in an apical four-chamber clip, selects ED/ES frames, and reports EF, EDV and ESV by Simpson's method of discs with automatic rejection of failed results and user contour editing. Cleared under K232500 (2023-10-26) on a retrospective study of 80 Lumify-acquired A4C clips (EF r=0.82 vs averaged manual tracing; 76/80 clips processed).
families.intended_use_quote: The intended use of the product is to collect ultrasound image data that may be used by clinicians for diagnostic and procedural purposes. The product shall provide the ability for gathering clinically acceptable images and ultrasound data for the clinical presets and anatomies listed under the indications for use.
families.indications_for_use_quote: The Philips Lumify Diagnostic Ultrasound System is intended for diagnostic ultrasound imaging in B(2D), Color Doppler, Combined (B+Color), Pulsed Wave Doppler, and M-modes. It is indicated for diagnostic ultrasound imaging and fluid flow analysis in the following applications: Fetal/Obstetric, Abdominal, Pediatric, Cephalic, Urology, Gynecological, Cardiac Fetal Echo, Small Organ, Musculoskeletal, Peripheral Vessel, Carotid, Cardiac, Lung.

embedded_ai_features.name: Auto EF Quantification
embedded_ai_features.function: AI (neural-network segmentation) automated LV border tracing and tracking across the cardiac cycle from a single A4C clip, automated ED/ES frame selection, Simpson's method-of-discs volumes; outputs EF, EDV and ESV for the default beat; automatic rejection of false results; user can edit the LV contour before accepting.
embedded_ai_features.quote: Auto EF is a new Artificial Intelligence (AI) feature available on the S4-1 transducer in the Cardiac Preset on the Lumify application based on the LVivo EF algorithm developed by DiA. Lumify Auto EF Quantification feature is a subset of LVivo platform. It provides automated assessment of the LV EF supporting evaluation from only apical four chamber (A4CH) view. The software automatically traces and tracks LV borders in each frame of the cardiac cycle and provides only the results for Ejection Fraction (EF), End Diastolic Volume (EDV), and End Systolic Volumes (ESV).

clearances.changes_summary: Introduced Auto EF Quantification (DiA LVivo EF subset) on Lumify 5.0 Android, S4-1 transducer, Cardiac preset; adds QIH as secondary product code. Retrospective clinical performance study on 80 Lumify-acquired A4C clips.

performance_claims.endpoint: Auto EF (LVivo EF) ejection fraction vs average manual tracing
performance_claims.comparator: Average EF from manual tracing by sonographers
performance_claims.dataset_description: A4C clips from 80 subjects referred for cardiac evaluation, acquired with Lumify; 57 male / 23 female; age 19-92 (mean 64 +/- 14); BMI 15.9-43.0 (mean 26.4, n=74); LV function normal 37.5%, mild 16.25%, moderate 25%, severe 21.25% dysfunction; CAD 42%; acquired consecutively for normal then impaired LV function; test data distinct from training data
performance_claims.subgroup_notes: LV-function distribution reported; no subgroup accuracy reported
performance_claims.quote: Strong correlation was demonstrated between LVivo EF ejection fraction (EF) measurements and the average results by manual tracing, r=0.82, 95% CI (0.72, 0.88), meeting the end point criteria.

performance_claims.endpoint: Auto EF end-diastolic volume vs manual tracing
performance_claims.comparator: Manual tracing by sonographers
performance_claims.quote: Additionally, strong correlations were demonstrated for end-diastolic volume (EDV) and end-systolic volume (ESV) with r=0.95, 95% CI (0.91, 0.96) and r= 0.94, 95% CI (0.90, 0.96), respectively.

performance_claims.endpoint: Auto EF end-systolic volume vs manual tracing
performance_claims.comparator: Manual tracing by sonographers
performance_claims.quote: Additionally, strong correlations were demonstrated for end-diastolic volume (EDV) and end-systolic volume (ESV) with r=0.95, 95% CI (0.91, 0.96) and r= 0.94, 95% CI (0.90, 0.96), respectively.

performance_claims.endpoint: Automatic processing success rate
performance_claims.quote: The LVivoEF automatically processed 76 out of 80 clips (95%).

training_data.description: Not disclosed in the K232500 summary; the summary states only that the test data were completely distinct from the algorithm training data. The algorithm is the DiA LVivo EF (K210053), whose training data are not described here.

validation_data.description: Retrospective clinical performance study: A4C clips from 80 subjects referred for cardiac evaluation, acquired consecutively with the Lumify device (normal LV function then impaired LV function); number of sites not stated.

prior_validations.description: Auto EF Quantification is a derivative of the previously cleared DiA LVivo EF module (K210053); AI/ML functionality stated to be the same as the reference device.
K232500 is cited in later Philips EPIQ/Affiniti clearances (K240850, K250886, K251455) as a basis for the Pearson-r lower-confidence-bound > 0.8 acceptance criterion.

papers.title: Pragmatic Evaluation of a Deep-Learning Algorithm to Automate Ejection Fraction on Hand-Held, Point-of-Care Echocardiography in a Cardiac Surgical Operating Room
papers.journal: Journal of Cardiothoracic and Vascular Anesthesia
papers.key_result: Prospective single-center (Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania) study of Lumify Auto EF on 54 A4C clips in cardiac surgical patients: vs Simpson's method, Auto EF bias -10.17% and r=0.56 (experienced reader visual EF r=0.80); r=0.86 in 27 adequate-quality acquisitions vs 0.46 in 27 inadequate ones.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence-Powered Measurement of Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction Using a Handheld Ultrasound Device
papers.key_result: LVivo software LVEF from A4C on a handheld device vs 3D LVEF on a stationary echocardiograph in 112 cardiology inpatients: r=0.92 (95% CI 0.87-0.95); mean difference -0.61% (NS). Handheld device vendor is not named in the abstract, so applicability to Lumify specifically is unconfirmed; same LVivo (DiA) algorithm family.

papers.title: The measurement of the left ventricle ejection fraction by a bedside FoCUS examination
papers.key_result: Bedside FoCUS in 59 emergency-medicine patients: LVEF by the LVivo app 39.5 +/- 12.0% vs 53.7 +/- 11.1% by standard echocardiography; correlation r=0.694. Handheld device not named in abstract.

open_questions: Number of sites for the 80-subject K232500 validation study is not stated.
Training-data size and composition for LVivo EF (K210053) are not disclosed in the K232500 summary.
Bland-Altman bias / limits of agreement for EF are not reported in the K232500 summary (only Pearson r).
Kagiyama 2024 (Sci Rep, PMID 38965290) multicenter handheld AI-EF study used the EchoNous KOSMOS, not Lumify, and was therefore excluded.
Filipiak-Strzecka 2021 and Martocchia 2023 use LVivo software on unnamed handheld devices; whether the device was Lumify could not be confirmed from abstracts (full text not accessible this session).
iOS availability: vendor page states Auto EF is available only on Lumify for Android; no later clearance for iOS was reviewed in this batch.

notes: All 11 included clearances were read in full from the FDA summary text files. Family (a) groups ten EPIQ/Affiniti/Compact 5000 clearances (K211597, K233788, K240850, K240980, K242800, K243794, K251110, K243793, K250886, K251455); family (b) is the single Lumify clearance K232500. Dates and product codes copied from openFDA. Performance numbers are verbatim from the summaries with PDF page numbers (PAGE markers in the txt files). Papers: 5 resolved for family (a) and 3 for family (b) via PubMed/Crossref; no peer-reviewed validation found by name for Auto Measure, Smart Doppler View ID, Smart View Select, or R-Trigger. Vendor claims (51% time saving) carry verification 'company'. HeartModel, 3D Auto MV/RV, AutoStrain LA/RV and Auto LAA appear on vendor pages but are not subjects of the included K-numbers and are not recorded as embedded features.
